description:
Analysis and reporting source code, software-environment records, and group-level imaging and behavioral summaries for an interleaved dual-structure serial reaction time fMRI study of motor sequence learning and gradual sequence updating.

The coverage-aware ROI reporting model is exploratory and was selected post hoc. The significant-effects table contains 49 ROI-stage estimates grouped into 31 ROI/laterality entries; stage counts are 29, 15, 5 and 0. The release includes complete group summaries, data dictionaries, checksums, and instructions for aggregate verification and table reproduction.

Participant-level MRI, behavioral trial logs, individual summaries and fitted model objects are excluded. Estimates based on fewer than two participants, and corresponding untestable-parcel stability summaries, are suppressed. Full model re-estimation requires approved access to restricted inputs and separately obtained third-party resources.
